answer: Registration with Disability Support Services is for students at the Malaysian campus, and the passages describe the steps: register with Disability Services, then a DSS adviser contacts you about adjustments, and you get an email confirmation if eligible. The passages do not say which form or portal to use, so check with the Disability Services office.

points.text: Register as soon as possible, because the assessment process can take some time.
points.quote: it’s a good idea to register as early as possible
points.title: Alternative assessment arrangements

points.text: Your registration needs an independent qualified health professional's report that states your condition, its impact on your academic life, and recommended accommodations.
points.quote: clearly state the condition, its impacts on your academic life, and recommendations for accommodations to address these impacts.
points.title: Register with Disability Services

points.text: A DSS adviser will contact you to discuss adjustments, by email, phone, or Zoom.
points.quote: A DSS adviser will get in touch with you to talk about any adjustments you may need for your learning.
points.title: Register with Disability Services

points.text: Your registration and discussions are private and do not appear on your academic record.
